title: Named summary grains
brief: Build summaries through explicitly named grains.
instructions: Return paid UTC 2024 revenue by UTC month. Build order-grain totals before month-grain totals. Preserve a month with only empty paid orders as zero.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving named summary grains.

hints.text: Each CTE should declare its result grain.
Build qualifying orders, then left-joined item totals per order, then monthly totals.
Order 12 is empty; an inner join must not define the paid-order population.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT count(*)::VARCHAR FROM order_items WHERE order_id = 12
